title: The curriculum meeting
situation: An international school is changing its curriculum. Next year it wants to add two new subjects, so two things have to go. Parents, teachers and students are meeting tonight to decide.

for: **Nobody ever taught us how to** make a budget, and my first credit card was a disaster.

against: **You pick it up along the way**, like everyone does.
